Select distinct rows of IC50 activity data for compounds tested against target CHEMBL5071 (Prostaglandin D2 receptor 2). Output columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures, INNER JOIN required so only compounds with structures are returned), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fall back to docs.doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment (all from activities), target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Join path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records (on molregno) -> docs (on doc_id) -> activities (on record_id) -> assays (on assay_id) -> target_dictionary (on tid). Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5071', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Deduplicate with DISTINCT. Sort by all output columns in listed order.
